jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. Seit 1993 besetzen wir Führungs, Management und C Level Positionen für exklusive Mandanten im deutschen Mittelstand und im Konzernumfeld. Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit Exklusivmandaten und diskreter Direktansprache. Über 1.400 erfolgreich abgeschlossene Searches sprechen für sich. Hinter dem Haus steht ein spezialisiertes, eingespieltes Team, in dem jede Rolle sichtbar ist und echten Impact hat. Für den weiteren Ausbau unserer Research und AI Kapazitäten suchen wir dich. Deine Rolle Du bist unser verlängerter Arm im Research und baust parallel unsere AI gestützten Prozesse mit auf. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Managing Partner und unserem Team zusammen und bekommst von Tag eins Einblick in reale Executive Searches, nicht in Powerpoint Projekte. Konkret heißt das: Du recherchierst Zielunternehmen, baust Longlists auf LinkedIn Recruiter und Sales Navigator, qualifizierst Profile vor und pflegst sie in unser internes CRM ein. Parallel bringst du moderne AI Tools in unseren Alltag, zum Beispiel für Profil Screening, Zusammenfassungen, Vorab-Checks von K.o. Kriterien oder automatisierte Datenanreicherung. Wenn du Lust hast, auch mal selbst zum Hörer zu greifen und an Gatekeepern vorbei zum Entscheider durchzukommen, ist das ein großes Plus. Deine Aufgaben Research und Longlist Aufbau für laufende Executive Search Mandate über LinkedIn Recruiter, Sales Navigator, XI

Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness consider

jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.
